summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release announcing a Term Sheet Agreement with Slate Falls Nation outlining key terms for a final Project Agreement on the Springpole Gold Project. The agreement details development parameters, regulatory collaboration, and financial participation mechanisms. There is no price per share, premium, or pending merger/acquisition. This is a community agreement and permitting step, not a special-situation transaction. The filing is a routine report of a project milestone, not an extraordinary corporate event covered by special-situation categories.
